principle: ONE content model. Every rendering target (print PDF, mobile PDF, on-screen Workbench preview) reads this object. No target owns fields the others cannot see. NOTHING in this file is populated from memory - every value carries a provenance mark and an absent value is absent, never a placeholder.

provenance_marks.MLS: VERIFIED MLS FACT - retrieved from Northstar/Matrix in the current research session
provenance_marks.REP: LISTING-REPORTED - listing text or listing-agent representation, not independently confirmed
provenance_marks.CALC: CALCULATED - derived here; must name the inputs it was derived from
provenance_marks.VER: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - not established. Never phrased as a defect.
provenance_marks.OBS: BLAISE PROFESSIONAL OBSERVATION - judgment, labeled as judgment
provenance_marks.BUYER: BUYER-REPORTED PRIORITY - stated by the buyer. Never inferred, never invented.
provenance_marks.AGENT_ONLY: AGENT-ONLY - MUST NOT RENDER in any client-facing output. Held for internal use.

field_shape.note: Every fact-bearing field in this schema is an object of this shape, never a bare scalar.
field_shape.mark: MLS | PUB | REP | CALC | VER | OBS | BUYER | AGENT_ONLY
field_shape.as_of: ISO-8601 date the value was retrieved or stated
field_shape.source_note: optional - which Matrix field, which conversation, which calculation

render_rules.null_value: Field is OMITTED from render. Never print an empty cell, a dash, or N/A.
render_rules.mark_VER: Renders as a dashed-red mark with a forward-looking phrase. Never as a defect or a deficiency.
render_rules.mark_AGENT_ONLY: Hard-blocked from every client-facing render target. Renderer must fail closed.
render_rules.empty_section: A section whose required fields are all null does not render at all.
render_rules.empty_comps: comps[] empty => market section collapses to the single line 'Value analysis pending verified MLS/comparable review.' Never an empty CMA table.

packet.research_request_id: string | null - links to the Matrix research packet that populated it
source_limitations: string - carried verbatim from the research packet

buyer.display_name: string - first name unless the buyer uses otherwise
buyer.note: priorities[] MUST come from FUB or a recorded conversation. An empty array renders as 'Tell me today', never as invented priorities.

showing.access_note: string | null - NEVER contains a lockbox code or access credential

facts_land.note: Rendered ONLY when property_type = LAND. Unknown is UNKNOWN/VERIFY - never a defect.

association.note: Entire module OMITTED when fee.value is null. No empty HOA box, ever.

investment.note: Module OMITTED when buy_box_on_file is false. Any CALC metric REQUIRES a populated assumptions[] printed on the same page. A metric without printed assumptions must not render.

standouts.headline: string
standouts.body: string - grounded in a marked fact above

market.comp_set_weak: boolean - true renders the FULL CMA RECOMMENDED line
market.note: comps[] empty => the whole section collapses to the pending line. NEVER fabricate a comp.

scorecard.note: Always rendered blank. This is the buyer's page, not Claude's.

default: Review verified market and value context
Prepare an offer only on the buyer's direction
next_steps.note: No pressure language. Offer preparation is buyer-directed and gated by SOP 04 / SOP 10 / SOP 11.
